results.title: China's answer to the Malacca problem was a pipeline from Myanmar to Yunnan.
results.description:
China's answer to the Malacca problem was a pipeline from Myanmar to Yunnan.

Capacity: about 440,000 barrels a day. China imports more than 10 million.

Here is the catch. The pipeline starts at a port. The oil gets there by tanker, from the Middle East and Africa. ⬇️

results.title: Why is Min Aung Hlaing pushing so hard to revive Myitsone Dam?
results.description:
Why is Min Aung Hlaing pushing so hard to revive Myitsone Dam?

He claims it’ll fix chronic blackouts, but under the contract, almost all the power gets exported straight to China. And how on earth does a bankrupt regime plan to repay massive debt for it?
